canonical_project: China Telecom Jiangxi Cloud and Big Data Center
notes: Jiangxi DRC approved the energy-saving report for the 2020 China Telecom (Jiangxi) cloud-computing big-data-center project at Nanchang Linkong Digital Economy Port. Later planning-permit notice covers A2 data center and A3 operations support center. Financial press reports total investment about RMB 2.1bn and 10,000 IDC racks at full build, but no MW disclosed.
